tex_content.label: prop:covering-locally-homogeneous
tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Riemannian Coverings Preserve Local Homogeneity] 1. ch3:3.20Let $(\widetilde M,\widetilde g)$ be homogeneous and let $\pi \colon (\widetilde M,\widetilde g)\to (M,g)$ be a Riemannian covering. Then $(M,g)$ is locally homogeneous. If $\widetilde M$ is frame-homogeneous, then $M$ is locally frame-homogeneous.
